question: Who became the record-holder for the most international football wins, with 132, by a male player in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cristiano Ronaldo**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cristiano Ronaldo** officially became the record-holder for the **most international football wins** by a male player in **March 2025**.
 
• He achieved his **132nd win** while representing the **Portugal national team**, surpassing the long-standing record previously held by **Sergio Ramos**.
 
• The milestone was reached during the international break in **March 2025**, further cementing his legacy as the most successful player in the history of men's international football. ***Hence, the statement regarding his record is correct.***
 
• Before this achievement, the record for most wins was **131**, held by the Spanish defender **Sergio Ramos**, who played for **Spain** during their golden era of dominance between **2008 and 2012**.
 
• **Ronaldo** has been a mainstay for **Portugal** since his debut in **2003**, and this record adds to his extensive list of international accolades, including being the all-time leading goalscorer in international football.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **International Career of Cristiano Ronaldo:**
 
 
• Born in **1985**, **Ronaldo** debuted for **Portugal** at the **age of 18**. He has since led his country to victory in the **UEFA Euro 2016** and the **UEFA Nations League 2019**.
 
• He holds the record for the **most international goals** scored by a male player, having crossed the **130-goal mark**.
 
• His career longevity is marked by his participation in five **FIFA World Cups** and five **UEFA European Championships**.
 
 
 
• **Other High-Ranking Players:**
 
 
• **Sergio Ramos (Spain):** Held the previous record with **131 wins**. He was a key part of the **Spain** squads that won the **2010 FIFA World Cup** and two **European Championships**.
 
• **Lionel Messi (Argentina):** One of **Ronaldo's** primary contemporaries, **Messi** has also crossed the **100-win threshold** with **Argentina**, notably winning the **2022 FIFA World Cup** and **Copa América**.
 
• **Robert Lewandowski (Poland):** While a prolific goalscorer, **Poland's** win-rate in international competitions has not allowed him to challenge the top of this specific list, though he remains one of the top scorers in **European football**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of the Record:**
 
 
• The **132-win milestone** reflects not just individual skill but the sustained competitiveness of the **Portugal** national team over **two decades**.
 
• Winning **132 matches** at the international level requires an immense number of appearances (caps), a record **Ronaldo** also holds with over **200 appearances**.
 
• This record is monitored by **FIFA** and statistical organizations like **IFFHS** to track the historical performance of athletes across **World Cup Qualifiers**, **Nations League**, and major tournaments.
